name: ai.privos.onboarding-mcp-app
title: PrivOS Onboarding MCP App
description: Onboarding for new hires on PrivOS: one roadmap template per position, one roadmap list per hire copied from the template, working-day deadlines, and progress tracking. All data lives in isolated PrivOS Lists.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so the dashboard can load safely.
Read onboarding templates, hire records and roadmap lists, fields, stages and items.
Filter and page onboarding items without a capped list fallback.
Create template lists, hire records and per-hire roadmap lists, and let each hire mark their own tasks done.
Read onboarding file metadata and open linked documents.
Upload onboarding documents to the room Files area.
List the members of the current room so HR can pick who to onboard from a dropdown.
permissions.degradedBehavior: HR types the hire's username (or user id) instead of picking from a list.

permissions.reason: Resolve a typed username to its user id when the member list is unavailable.
permissions.degradedBehavior: HR must type the hire's user id instead of a username.

dataPolicy.retention: Onboarding templates, hire records and roadmap lists are stored as PrivOS Lists in the room and are retained until they are deleted in the room or the installation is removed.

tools.name: onboarding_dashboard
tools.title: Onboarding
tools.description: Open the onboarding workspace: position templates, hire roadmaps and progress.
